description: This source file implements a Tuner class within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace, providing functionality for DVB frontend tuning, filtering, and status monitoring on Linux systems. It includes DVB API interactions, tuner configuration, and filtering mechanisms.

classes.name: Tuner
classes.description: Represents a DVB tuner device, providing methods for tuning, status monitoring, filtering, and configuration within the Linux DVB API context.

classes.name: Tuner::Observer
classes.description: Manages thread-based monitoring of tuner status changes and registered tuner callbacks.

classes.name: Tuner::MuxFilter
classes.description: Handles filtering of MPEG sections via Linux DVB demux device, managing filter setup and data reading.

classes.name: Tuner::Information
classes.description: Singleton class storing tuner configuration, supported types, and capabilities, initialized from JSON configuration.

methods.name: Tuner::Create
methods.description: Creates a new Tuner instance based on configuration string.

methods.name: Tuner::Tune
methods.description: Configures the tuner hardware to lock onto a specified frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and inversion.

methods.name: Tuner::Filter
methods.description: Sets up or removes a filter for specific PID and table ID, with callback for sections.

methods.name: Tuner::Properties
methods.description: Returns tuner properties such as support for annex, standard, and mode.

methods.name: Tuner::Id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the current transport stream lock.

methods.name: Tuner::Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the tuner for a specific program ID (stub implementation).

methods.name: Tuner::Dispatch
methods.description: Checks frontend status, updates lock state, and triggers callbacks.
